annotations.title: Cast a BaZi chart (true solar time first)

description: Casts a BaZi (Four Pillars) chart from a birth date, time and place, applying true solar time correction first (daylight saving, longitude and the equation of time). Returns the four pillars with hidden stems and Na Yin, the day master, the season, and the luck-cycle sequence, plus the same birth cast from raw clock time, showing which pillars (if any) the correction changes for this birth. The result has a formatted scroll (the display form) and the same data as structured fields. Runs on the production Auspice Oracle engine (conventions at auspiceoracle.com/en/method). Deterministic calendar facts only: no strength verdicts, favorable elements or interpretation. The output is calendar data only and is not a forecast; the luck-cycle sequence is a charting convention, not a timetable of fortune, money, property, relationships, health or decisions. What the chart can describe is temperament and tendency.

gender.description: Sets luck-cycle direction (a charting convention, not an identity statement)

timeZone.description: IANA time zone of the birthplace, e.g. 'Asia/Shanghai', 'America/Vancouver'

year.description: Birth year, Gregorian calendar (engine ephemeris covers 1900–2100)

castFrom.description: The instant the chart was cast from (true solar time), YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm
